description: SP01 retrieval validation. Each case is a short interaction with a metadata predicate identifying its relevant SME calibration feedback.

cases.title: Concrete site preparation before pitching
cases.transcript:
[00:10] Ranjit: Proposal dekha? Site visit kiya tha?
[00:16] Officer: Ji. Kal tower 3 aur 4 dekhe. West exposure open hai aur elevation grooves zyada hain, isliye coverage actual surface condition par rakha hai. Pehle BOQ ke against do points discuss karna chahta hoon.

cases.title: Brand pitch without visiting the site
cases.transcript:
[00:05] Ranjit: Site dekh li?
[00:08] Officer: Abhi visit nahi kiya, lekin drawing padh li. Hamari company market leader hai aur quality mein kisi se kam nahi. Main premium product explain karta hoon.

cases.title: BOQ-compliant and costed-upgrade choices
cases.transcript:
[01:20] Officer: Ek proposal exactly aapke BOQ ke hisaab se hai. Doosre mein do upgrades hain aur cost difference alag column mein diya hai. Aap line-by-line compare karke jo suitable ho choose kijiye.
[01:42] Ranjit: Dono proposal aur comparison sheet de dijiye.

cases.title: Ownership, diagnosis, and execution controls
cases.transcript:
[02:30] Ranjit: Pichhle project mein do saal mein patches aa gaye.
[02:38] Officer: Execution ki responsibility company ki bhi hai. Kaam kis season mein hua aur coat interval kya tha?
[03:10] Ranjit: Monsoon mein start hua tha.
[03:18] Officer: Is baar trained applicator, surface-readiness sign-off, wall-level consumption reconciliation aur weekly monitoring rakhenge.

cases.title: Blaming application before asking questions
cases.transcript:
[01:25] Ranjit: Isi product mein pichhli baar patches aaye the.
[01:31] Officer: Application galat hui hogi. Surface preparation theek na ho toh product kya karega? Hamara product bilkul theek hai.
[01:44] Ranjit: Matlab galti hamari thi?

cases.title: Unverified criticism of the incumbent
cases.transcript:
[02:20] Ranjit: Vanguard das saal se hamare saath hai. Aapko kyun consider karein?
[02:28] Officer: Company achhi hai, par suna hai unki service aur supply aajkal weak hai.
[02:40] Ranjit: Kahan suna?
[02:43] Officer: Market mein baatein hoti rehti hain.

cases.title: Grant incumbent quality and ask for sampling
cases.transcript:
[05:05] Ranjit: Existing supplier se koi complaint nahi.
[05:12] Officer: Unka product achha hai. Main unhe remove karne ko nahi keh raha. Humein bhi sampling list mein rakhiye aur west-exposure wali hamari three-year-old site verify kar lijiye.

cases.title: Reducing apparent cost through unsupported coverage
cases.transcript:
[03:00] Ranjit: Rate kya rahega?
[03:06] Officer: Vanguard se kam hi dunga. Coverage ko thoda practical maan lete hain toh consumption kam dikhega aur total cost neeche aa jayegi.
[03:24] Ranjit: Coverage badal kaise sakte ho?

cases.title: Unsupported validity and tripartite promises
cases.transcript:
[04:05] Ranjit: Rate 12 months hold chahiye.
[04:11] Officer: Difficult hai, par aapke liye ho jayega. Senior se baat karke karwa dunga.
[05:00] Ranjit: Tripartite agreement bhi chahiye.
[05:07] Officer: Project bada hai, mujhe lagta hai woh bhi ho jana chahiye.

cases.title: Holding boundaries while offering controlled alternatives
cases.transcript:
[06:40] Ranjit: Twelve-month written validity de do.
[06:48] Officer: Six months standard hai. Raw-material movement mere control mein nahi, isliye main false commitment nahi dunga; market changes aaye toh cooperative discussion karenge.
[08:35] Officer: Tripartite legal allow nahi karta, lekin written warranty, monitoring, reconciliation aur applicator accountability de sakta hoon.

cases.title: Specific deliverables, timing, and next meeting
cases.transcript:
[09:15] Ranjit: Details mail kar dena.
[09:20] Officer: Aaj shaam dono proposals, BOQ comparison aur two client references bhejunga. Revised quotation kal evening tak. Do din baad call karke applicator ke saath meeting time lock karte hain.
[09:45] Ranjit: Revised quotation bhejo aur call kar lena.

cases.title: Accepting send-details without a dated next step
cases.transcript:
[05:45] Ranjit: Project list, applicator list aur comparison mail kar do; dekh kar connect karenge.
[05:55] Officer: Ji, kal tak bhej dunga. Main follow-up karta rahunga. Month end hai, jaldi dekh lijiyega.
[06:20] Ranjit: Haan, dekh lenge.

cases.title: Unverifiable 95 percent performance claim
cases.transcript:
[03:35] Officer: Hamare proposed applicators ke 95 percent projects time par aur bina rework close hote hain.
[03:44] Ranjit: 95 percent? Data dikha sakte ho?
[03:49] Officer: Exact report abhi nahi hai, par record bahut strong hai.

cases.title: Performance and service substance before price
cases.transcript:
[05:40] Ranjit: Product sab same hain; rate batao.
[05:46] Officer: Rate revised quotation mein clear rahega. Pehle execution substance: fourteen towers ki supply planning, weekly site report, consumption reconciliation aur documentation support. Price actual coverage par hi calculate hoga.
